I've been a diehard PC gamer all my life, but as someone who works 8 hours a day at a computer, sometimes I don't want to sit on a gaming chair and want to give my neck and shoulders a break. Whilst I could plug in a controller to my PC, I'd still have to use a keyboard and mouse occationally. And I'm not plugging my PC to my living room TV. #gaming

https://mastodon.social/@gerowen/1175461.text: So AMD FSR is finally good enough for me. #Bazzite has added the FSR 4 flag by default now if you use a compatible version of Proton and GPU, so even if a game doesn't "say" FSR4 in its settings, FSR 3.1 gets auto upgraded to FSR 4 at a driver level with the latest Proton GE on Bazzite. I've tinkered with FSR in the past and it always just looked bad; weird grainy artifacts, particle effects being butchered or erased, etc. But FSR 4 is really good, like native resolution good. #Gaming #PCGaming
